name: Dharani Finance Limited
about: Dharani Finance Limited provides non-banking financial services in India. It offers working capital loans, purchase of equipment and machinery loans, business or capacity expansion loans, and term loans against property; personal financing solution; and foreign exchange solutions. It also provides financial services, such as leasing, investment planning, and consultancy services. In addition, the company provides travel and tourism services. Dharani Finance Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Chennai, India.
